project.name: Castellan APM :: Core
project.description: Framework-agnostic tracing model: Span/Trace, a ThreadLocal-plus-context-propagation trace context (W3C traceparent format), the adaptive sampler, an exporter SPI, and the wire model shared with apm-collector. No bytecode manipulation lives here (see apm-agent) — this module is what the agent's woven-in calls actually invoke at runtime.
